summary: The change maps CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>DECODE_BASE64 (static and via IF_HTTP_UTILITY) to a new abap.DecodeBase64, which reuses the existing Node-compatible DecodeXBase64 and adds a WHATWG-style nodeutf8.Decode. I fuzzed it differentially against Node: 200k random byte strings for nodeutf8.Decode and 50k random base64-ish strings for DecodeBase64 (mixed alphabets, '=', spaces, junk), with 0 mismatches. A scratch ABAP unit class covering named, positional and variable arguments plus strlen of multibyte results passes under osgo. Only cosmetic issues remain.

findings.claim: The new test file is not gofmt-clean: trailing comment alignment in the table differs from gofmt output.

The 'truncated at end' and 'invalid continuation' branches both append the same U+FFFD, so the if/else-if/else could collapse to two cases. The local 'first' flag is also redundant, because lo/hi are already reset to 0x80..0xBF after the first continuation byte. This is harmless but adds noise.
